name: tamanna-ai
description: Tamanna AI project tools and static web frontend
author: HM INSAN ALI

scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run check:cloudflare && npm run deploy
scripts.api:dev: cd cloudflare/backend && uv run pywrangler dev
scripts.api:deploy: cd cloudflare/backend && uv run pywrangler deploy
scripts.api:db:create: cd cloudflare/backend && npx wrangler d1 create tamanna-ai-db
scripts.api:db:migrate: cd cloudflare/backend && npx wrangler d1 execute tamanna-ai-db --remote --file=./schema.sql
